entity.name: Dirk Farin
entity.description: Author and sole maintainer of libheif (HEIF/AVIF file format library) and libde265 (H.265/HEVC decoder). These libraries are used by practically all open-source software that reads or writes HEIC and AVIF images, including ImageMagick, GIMP, libvips/sharp, Pillow, darktable, digiKam, GDAL and the GNOME and KDE desktops, and through these by a large number of web services and image pipelines. The work is currently almost entirely unfunded: in 2026 alone, 37 security advisories had to be investigated, fixed and released in unpaid evenings and weekends.

projects.name: libheif
projects.description: ISO/IEC 23008-12 HEIF and AVIF file format decoder and encoder. Supports HEIC, AVIF, VVC, AVC, JPEG, JPEG 2000 and uncompressed (ISO/IEC 23001-17) codecs, image sequences, tiling, HDR, metadata and region annotations. Continuously fuzzed on OSS-Fuzz.

projects.name: libde265
projects.description: Open source H.265/HEVC video decoder, used by libheif as the default HEIC decoder.

channels.description: GitHub Sponsors, monthly or one-time. Organizations can pay by invoice through GitHub.
Bank transfer against an invoice for commercial support agreements, sponsored features and grants. Contact dirk.farin@gmail.com.

plans.name: Sustained maintenance and security response
plans.description: Funds about two days per week of maintenance for libheif and libde265: triage and fixing of security reports, fuzzing, security releases, keeping up with the ISO/IEC 23008-12 specification, and platform/compiler support. This is the amount that would move security work from weekends into regular working hours.

plans.name: Security hardening sprint
plans.description: A scoped, one-time project: systematic hardening of one subsystem (box parser, image sequences, uncompressed codec, derived images), extension of the fuzzing corpus and harnesses, and a security release. Deliverables and scope are agreed in advance.

plans.name: Sponsored feature development
plans.description: Development of a specific feature or codec integration that your product needs (for example hardware-accelerated codecs, new ISO/IEC 23008-12 amendments, GIMI/geospatial extensions). Priced per project.

plans.name: Any amount
plans.description: Any recurring or one-time contribution helps to keep libheif and libde265 maintained.
